ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: on a bypassed story that still has issues, only a release engineer (custom permission Bypass_Verification_Gate) may check Ready to Promote.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Story_Verification_Control__c.Disable_Story_Verification__c), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c)), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Issues"), Bypass_Verification__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Verification for this story was bypassed, but it still has issues. Only a release engineer can check Ready to Promote.
